grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: Topic 1.3 File Management
topics.description: This topic introduces learners to the basics of file management, focusing on how to organize, name, and handle files and folders properly. Proper file management helps keep a computer organized, increases work efficiency, and makes retrieving files easier.

sub_topics.name: Sub topic 1.3.1 Basics of file management
sub_topics.description: This sub-topic covers essential skills needed to manage digital files and folders effectively, including creating, organizing, naming, storing, and retrieving files in a structured way to maintain clean and efficient computer systems.

competencies.description: Organize and manage files and folders

topics.name: Topic 1.4: Basics of the Internet and Online Tools
topics.description: This topic introduces learners to the basics of the Internet and common online tools, explaining how the Internet works, its main services, and the tools used for online communication and teamwork.

sub_topics.name: 1.4.1 Basics of the Internet and Online Tools
sub_topics.description: Focuses on understanding how the internet operates, utilizing online tools to search and navigate the web, and implementing essential online safety practices.

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of how internet works
Use online tools to search and navigate the internet
